title: Evidence: Phone Condition Photos

attachments.platform_description: Three scuff marks visible on the Phantom Black back glass. Each measures under 5mm. Visible in normal indoor lighting. Marks are superficial surface abrasions; no cracks or chips present.
attachments.title: Photo 1: Back Glass Scuffs

attachments.platform_description: Hairline scratch on the screen, visible with display off at an angle. The scratch runs approximately 1.5 inches diagonally in the lower third of the display. No depth or texture change detectable from photo.
attachments.title: Photo 2: Screen Scratch

attachments.platform_description: Close-up of the S Pen tip. Tip shows slight flattening consistent with use. No cracking or structural damage to the tip.
attachments.title: Photo 3: S Pen Tip

attachments.platform_description: Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra in Phantom Black, held in hand. Device shows cosmetic wear consistent with regular use (scuffs and minor scratches as documented in other photos). Screen and body intact. All buttons and ports visually present.
attachments.title: Photo 4: Overall Appearance

submitted_text:
"Refurbished" to me means the device has been restored to a like-new state. This phone clearly has not been restored — it has been cleaned and had its battery replaced, but all the cosmetic damage remains. This is more accurately described as "Used - Good" not "Refurbished - Good."
